metadata.description: ideas42-specific Claude plugins organized by the AI Builders framework domains: brand, communications, research and evaluation, behavioral diagnosis, governance, and workspace operations.

plugins.name: brand-systems
plugins.description: Framework domain: Design. Brand rules for ideas42, Year Up, Calbright, Bottom Line, and SBNC/Navvy, applied to any deliverable.

plugins.name: ideas42-comms
plugins.description: Framework domain: Governance floor and Communications craft. Write in the ideas42 voice: copy editing, internal communications formats, learning support, and removing AI-tell patterns from drafts.

plugins.name: research-and-evaluation
plugins.description: Framework domains: Research and Evaluation (REL). Evidence scans, quantitative data cleaning and description, verification of AI-generated analyses, visualization, and qualitative journey mapping.

plugins.name: behavioral-diagnosis
plugins.description: Framework domains: Implementation and Design. ideas42 diagnosis tools, starting with the behavioral communications auditor. B-mapping, process-mapping auditing, and the behavioral-concepts canon are scoped next.

plugins.name: governance
plugins.description: Framework domain: Governance. The verification backbone and responsible-use defaults: structured multi-reviewer QA, a review console for comparing options, and choosing the right Claude surface, model, and effort.

plugins.name: claude-ops
plugins.description: Framework domain: Implementation. Claude workspace operations tuned to how ideas42 works: project setup, memory import and consolidation, file organizing, scheduling, Cowork setup, and plugin and skill tooling.
